ctx.x: Let's see. Including Maxwell Davis or Bumps Myers. Most of the time I had both of them on the date, on the same date. Their styles were very similar. But this was... I did some things for that company that I like very much. One was "Voodoo," which I know you never heard, but I happened to be up in Sacramento on one of those...what do you call them... They had these things up there every year...
